title: ColdStart private task report
description: Full-detail report for one (task, system) pair, for internal/reviewer use only. May include individual attempts, failed verifier-check names, job/trial identifiers, raw artifact references, and exception details.

orchestration_run_id.description: Present when this report was generated by `coldctl eval run`/`resume`/`regenerate-reports`; scopes the report to exactly that orchestration run's trials, never all history for the (task, system) pair. Absent for plain Phase 1 all-history reports (e.g. `coldctl reports task`).
